kept.excerpt: Kylian Mbappe scored his seventh goal of the FIFA World Cup 2026 as France overcame Paraguay 1-0 to set up a quarter-final meeting with Morocco. Morocco await France at Boston Stadium on 9 July. France dominated possession but struggled to break down Paraguay’s disciplined defence in the first half.
kept.relevance: Establishes France’s latest completed match, continued participation and next scheduled opponent using the market’s official resolution source.

kept.excerpt: France won their fifth match of the 2026 World Cup by defeating Paraguay 1-0. Across those five matches, France had scored 14 goals and conceded two.
kept.relevance: Provides an explicitly dated cumulative team-goal total, the quantity directly relevant to this market.

kept.excerpt: Kylian Mbappe had his third two-goal game of this World Cup as France defeated Sweden 3-0 to reach the round of 16. His six tournament goals drew him level with Lionel Messi for the scoring lead.
kept.relevance: Documents France’s attacking production in the preceding knockout round and Mbappe’s scoring form.

kept.excerpt: France scored four goals against Norway despite generating 1.31 expected goals. France recorded 18 shots and nine shots on target, while Norway generated 1.69 expected goals and four big chances. Erling Haaland did not play.
kept.relevance: Adds underlying chance-quality evidence and opponent-selection context for assessing whether France’s scoring rate is sustainable.

kept.excerpt: Argentina defeated Cape Verde 3-2 after extra time to reach the World Cup last 16. An own goal in the 111th minute decided the match, and Argentina were scheduled to face Egypt next. Lionel Messi opened the scoring with his seventh goal of the tournament.
kept.relevance: Shows that another major attacking contender remained in the competition with a round-of-16 match still to play.

kept.excerpt: Jude Bellingham’s first-half double and a Harry Kane penalty gave England a 3-2 victory over Mexico at the Azteca Stadium. England advanced to the FIFA World Cup 2026 quarter-finals.
kept.relevance: Confirms that England added three goals and retained opportunities to increase its tournament total in later rounds.

kept.excerpt: Spain substitute Mikel Merino scored in the 91st minute to secure a 1-0 victory over Portugal in the World Cup last 16. Spain advanced to the quarter-finals, where they were scheduled to face the United States or Belgium.
kept.relevance: Establishes another contender’s advancement and modest latest goal increment, both relevant to the remaining race for total team goals.

search_notes: Frozen cutoff: 2026-07-06. Selected seven sources with explicit publication dates visible in search-index text, all on or before the cutoff. Excerpts are factual paraphrases of retrieved source text. web_fetch failed because of provider configuration; the requested agent-reach web-read fallback returned RATE_LIMITED, so full-page verification was unavailable. Search-index evidence supplied the publication dates and quoted facts. Excluded undated statistics pages, rolling pages containing later developments, post-cutoff reports, betting pages, prediction markets and odds. France’s 14-goal total is documented by a dated report, but a complete official team-goal leaderboard as of the cutoff was not verified; no claim of sole leadership is made. Individual scoring figures provide attacking context and are not treated as team totals or team-level tiebreaking rules.
